overall: The AG found no violation on the two notice/procedure allegations and held the Board may continue withholding its Sept. 8, 2014 executive session minutes under Purpose 6 because confidentiality purpose remains ongoing.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to state before entering executive session on Sept. 8, 2014 that it would take votes there.
allegations.key_passage: A public body does not need to identify prior to entering into executive session whether votes will be taken.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board cancelled a Sept. 11, 2014 hearing without giving the public 48 hours' notice.
allegations.key_passage: Additionally, a public body does not need to provide 48 hours' notice before cancelling a meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint sought public release of the Board's Sept. 8, 2014 executive session minutes, which the Board has withheld.
allegations.key_passage: The executive session purpose continues to justify confidentiality as the Board is now engaged in a lawsuit with the complainant regarding the layout of the Road and because the Board continues to have a negotiating position to protect until a final layout for Hatchery Road is resolved.
